Why Sony Interactive Entertainment?

We are looking for an experienced, hands-on Software Development Engineer in Test II (SDET II) to help build reliable, scalable Subscription and Streaming experiences.
This opportunity is suited for an engineer who enjoys solving complex technical problems, developing automation solutions, and improving quality across applications, services, and connected platforms.
Role Overview
As an SDET , you will collaborate with Software Engineers, Product Managers, and Quality Engineering teams to deliver subscription experiences across PlayStation platforms.
You will take ownership of testing and automation for assigned features, contribute to technical solutions, and help improve how quality is built into the development process.
Your work will span subscription and commerce services, backend APIs, mobile applications, gaming consoles, streaming services, and connected device experiences.
You will have opportunities to expand your technical expertise while working with experienced engineers across multiple teams.
Responsibilities
Design, develop, and improve automated testing solutions for subscription services, applications, and connected platforms.
Take ownership of quality engineering activities for assigned features, from test planning through automation and release validation.
Collaborate with engineering teams early in development to identify quality risks, improve testability, and determine effective testing approaches.
Develop reusable automation tools and framework capabilities that improve test coverage, reliability, and engineering efficiency.
Validate end-to-end customer journeys involving authentication, commerce, entitlements, subscription lifecycle management, retention, and streaming experiences.
Build automated tests for APIs, backend services, distributed systems, web applications, and native mobile platforms.
Integrate automated testing into CI/CD pipelines and contribute to improving test execution reliability and feedback.
Investigate complex failures, analyze root causes, and work with engineering teams to resolve issues.
Contribute to quality metrics, dashboards, and reporting that provide visibility into automation coverage and release readiness.
Identify opportunities to improve testing practices, reduce technical debt, and strengthen overall product quality.
Collaborate with globally distributed engineering and QE teams on integration testing and release qualification.
Explore emerging technologies, including AI-assisted testing, to improve test development and engineering workflows.

Bachelor’s degree or equivalent in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
3+ years of experience in Software Development Engineering in Test, Software Engineering, Quality Engineering, or Test Automation.
Proficiency in at least one programming language, such as Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, or Swift.
Experience developing automated tests and working with test automation frameworks.
Experience testing APIs, backend services, web applications, or native mobile applications.
Understanding of software testing methodologies, test design, and automation strategies.
Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, version control, and modern software development practices.
Experience investigating technical issues, debugging failures, and collaborating with engineering teams on solutions.
Ability to manage assigned work independently, communicate technical findings, and collaborate across teams.

Experience testing distributed systems, microservices, or cloud-based applications.
Experience with automation technologies such as XCUITest, Appium, Selenium, or API testing frameworks.

Experience testing streaming services, media playback, gaming consoles, or connected devices.
Experience with React Native or other cross-platform application frameworks.
Experience developing end-to-end automation across client applications and backend services.
Familiarity with observability, telemetry, and quality reporting.
Exposure to AI-assisted testing and automation tools.

You enjoy understanding how systems work and finding practical ways to improve their quality.
You are comfortable working across different technologies, investigating complex issues, and translating requirements into effective testing solutions.
You bring hands-on engineering experience, take ownership of your work, and collaborate with others to solve problems.
You are interested in continuing to develop your technical expertise while contributing to reliable, high-quality PlayStation experiences.

SambaNova is a leader in next-generation AI infrastructure, delivering a full-stack inference platform for customers worldwide. At the core of SambaNova's technology is the RDU (Reconfigurable Dataflow Unit) — a chip built on a dataflow architecture rather than the traditional GPU model. Its decode performance is especially strong for agentic workloads like multi-turn agents, code generation, and long-running applications. RDUs are packaged into SambaRack, rack-scale hardware that lets customers deploy state-of-the-art models with better performance, greater energy efficiency, and faster time to value.
About the Team
The compiler team at SambaNova powers the RDU through a unique compilation strategy. By fusing kernels into dataflow graphs that run across the entire accelerator architecture, we avoid sequential kernel launches and eliminate the memory traffic that bottlenecks conventional hardware. This is a key differentiator and unlike any other product on the market.
About the Role
As a new grad Compiler Engineer, you'll work on core areas of our compiler, including the IR and pass infrastructure, model lowering and partitioning, tensor tiling, memory management, and mapping operations onto the fabric. Compiler and hardware design are closely linked here, and you'll see how compiler decisions affect chip performance. You'll write production code in C++ and Python, debug at a low level, and work with the runtime and hardware teams. Senior engineers will review your code and mentor you as you take on larger parts of the compiler.
Responsibilities
Implement and optimize passes in the compiler's IR and pass infrastructure
Lower and partition machine learning models for execution on the RDU
Develop tensor tiling and memory management for on-chip memory
Map operations onto the RDU fabric to improve model performance
Debug compiler and performance issues at a low level in C++ and Python
Required Qualifications
B.S. in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related field
Experience in machine learning systems development, including ML compilers, LLM inference kernels, or kernel generation
Strong programming skills in Python and C/C++
Experience programming GPUs or other AI accelerators
Preferred Qualifications
M.S. or Ph.D. in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related field
Experience with ML compiler frameworks such as MLIR or StableHLO
Experience with LLM kernel libraries
Machine learning systems research experience
Open source project ownership or contributions
Experience building AI agent driven tools or automation
